tasks.budget_justification: PHASE (a) BISECTION AT (d=512, beta=40), ISOLATED-LLL-STEP LEVEL, REUSING probe1_bisection_generality.py's OWN HARNESS DIRECTLY: the Red Team's own OBJ-1/CTRL-1 control already brackets d=512's own boundary to (65, 100] bits at this level, with seed_used=2074339090 (matching TASK-20260814-534f80's own reported main-grid seed at (d=512, beta=40)), and reports trial costs of 362.9s (65 bits, ERROR) and 365.5s (100 bits, COMPLETED) -- both dominated by the outer, construction-independent LLL.reduction(A) pass, which this goal's own OBJ-3 decomposition already shows is identical in cost regardless of the later mpfr precision choice. A 1-bit-resolution bisection over a 35-bit-wide window (65..100) needs at most ceil(log2(35))=6 bisection trials plus the 2 endpoint-reconfirmation trials TASK-20260814-534f80's own bisect_precision() design always runs first (reused directly, not reinvented, per DEC-20260814-8ec2e5's own instruction) -- at most 8 trials. At the largest observed per-trial cost (413.6s, the largest d=512 main-grid subprocess wall-clock this goal has measured), 8 trials cost at most 3308.8s. BISECTION_D512_BUDGET_SECONDS=3600s (1h) is sized just above that worst case, and matches DEC-20260814-8ec2e5's own next_actions (a) independent characterization ('well under an hour total'). BISECTION_D512_TRIAL_CAP_SECONDS=900s per individual trial (>2x the largest single observed trial) leaves headroom for host variance without materially loosening the 3600s overall bisection budget. PHASE (b) FULL-BKZ-TOUR REATTEMPT OF THE THREE d=512 MAIN-GRID CELLS: PER_BASIS_FEASIBILITY_CAP_V2=7200s is EXPLICITLY NOT copied forward, because it was sized against 65-bit-precision full-tour trials (TASK-20260814-534f80's own budget_justification), and this task's own cells run at whatever higher precision phase (a) determines -- plausibly, though not certainly, crossing the 64-bit GMP/mpfr limb boundary at 129 bits (65 and 100 bits both fit in 2 64-bit limbs; 129+ bits needs 3, which this goal has not measured the per-operation cost of). Separately, d=512 is 2x d=256's own dimension, and this goal's ONLY measured full-tour-level data (the d=256 main-grid cells, all at 65-bit precision) shows costs of 223.4s-626.5s before erroring, plus one cell (d=256, beta=70) exhausting the FULL 7200s cap without resolving either way -- and BKZ's own per-tour GSO-update and bookkeeping costs typically scale at least linearly, and enumeration runs roughly d-beta+1 many per-tour sub-calls, so a d=512 tour that gets past d=512's own prior near-instant isolated-step failures (previously erroring within ~5s residual per the Red Team's own OBJ-3) could plausibly need meaningfully more wall-clock than the d=256 cells did to reach comparable progress. Scaling PER_BASIS_FEASIBILITY_CAP_V2 by the dimension ratio (512/256=2) gives PER_BASIS_FEASIBILITY_CAP_V3=14400s (4h) per cell -- an explicit, disclosed, approximate heuristic (not a rigorously fitted complexity bound; this goal has no measured d-scaling exponent for a COMPLETED full tour to fit one to), chosen over leaving the cap unchanged (repeating the exact under-provisioned-cap pattern this task exists to correct) and over an unbounded cap (which would tie up compute past the point where a disclosed NOT_COMPUTED is more useful than continuing to wait). 3 cells x 14400s = 43200s worst case. OVERALL_BUDGET_SECONDS = 3600 (bisection) + 43200 (3 reattempt cells) + WRITE_BUFFER_SECONDS(600s, doubled from TASK-20260814-534f80's own 180s given this task's own larger overall budget) = 47400s, rounded up to OVERALL_BUDGET_SECONDS=48000s (13h20m) as this task's own hard wall-clock cap, with an outer OS-level `timeout` backstop at 48060s (60s margin, matching precedent's convention). MEMORY_GB=16 (unchanged from TASK-20260814-534f80's own precedent -- peak RSS observed there was ~139MB max even at d=512, and higher mpfr precision does not plausibly demand orders of magnitude more memory at this dimension). MAXIMUM_RUNS=1 (a single script execution covering both phases, matching TASK-20260814-534f80's own precedent design). GOAL-MLKEM-005's own campaign_budget is deliberately unbounded per the user's explicit instruction, but that does not license skipping per-task budget discipline (per this task's own constraint) -- this is a large but explicitly bounded, explicitly justified single-task cap, not an open-ended run.
